heard: Did you know there's a mirror on the moon? Apollo astronauts left glass reflectors on its surface. A telescope on Earth fires a laser pulse. About two and a half seconds later, a little light returns. Timing that round trip revealed the moon is drifting away about an inch and a half each year. Why divide the travel time by two to find the distance?
